title: Little Lola Visits the City
description: Lola helps a family of elephants cross the road, helps a cat off a tall tree, finds out what's in the box Maria has brought Penguin.

title: Little Lola Visits the City
description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Elephant get to the balloon shop and the park.

title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
description: Come along and help Lola decorate bull with fresh flowers! See how horse helps foal reach the apples! Enjoy watching dandy dog flip over.

title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
description: Join Lola as she has fun on the farm. Play along with scarecrow and two darling doves! See how radiant ram helps lamb reach the tasty oranges.

title: Ahoy Lollipops
description: On their way to finding the treasure, the Lollipops need to cross a bubbly swamp. Luckily Ari the monkey is there to help.

title: Snail Trail
description: Mr. Snail discovers a nest on a porch! Join him as he sees a little chick hatch from its egg.

title: Snail Trail
description: Snail explores grass in a garden! Join him as he meets a grasshopper! Discover how his green colour helps him hide from lizards.

title: Songs & Rhymes
description: Little Cabin in the Woods is a popular and fun song that teaches toddlers and young children colors and shapes with yummy fruits.

title: Travelers
description: On your marks, get set, go! Harley and Perry are off on a race in their rubber duck boats. Harley is out to win and isn't playing fair.

title: Pix & Leo
description: Pix and Leo go to a lot of trouble trying to get a bunch of grapes hanging from a tall tree. Mama bird also has her eyes on the grapes.

title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
description: Mowgli has a tough time falling asleep with all the noises he hears in the jungle. He decides to sing to himself which helps him calm down.

title: Zeina's Detective Agency
description: An umbrella arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Using her detective skill and her best friend Roy, Zeina discovers that an umbrella is used for flying in the wind... is it?..

title: Zeina's Detective Agency
description: A tambourine arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Using her detective skill and her best friend Roy, Zeina discovers that a tambourine is used for jumping... is it.

title: Songs & Rhymes
description: Come ride through the town with your favorite BabyTV characters - Baby Butterfly, Elephant, Giraffe, Sheep, Rabit and Squirrel.

title: Mike's Bike
description: Tommy is tired of always being last. Everyone always has to wait for him because he's the slowest. Can Mike think of something that can help Tommy.

title: Mike's Bike
description: Petite is dressed up as a cute little mouse and she wants her bike to be dressed up, too. Will Mikey have a costume for her bike.

title: Mike's Bike
description: Johnny and Hal want to ride together, but they can't... Johnny rides too fast, and Hal rides too slowly.

title: Mona & Sketch
description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a shovel and a sieve! Help Mona dig in the ground and discover an ancient treasure.

title: Mona & Sketch
description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles wooden planks and tools! Step into the workshop and build a table and chair.

title: Mice Builders
description: Join the mighty mice builders as they work and play! Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? A chair to sit on while eating a tasty meal.

title: Billy BamBam
description: Billy and Bam Bam have fun playing with the little doll house and doll family they received as a present.

title: Billy BamBam
description: When the kites get stuck, they are left with the strings and find imaginative ways to play with them and wag their new "tails".

title: Songs & Rhymes
description: Squirrel is sleeping soundly when the ferry Ki takes him on a magical journey in the sky. Join them as they float through the stars and the moon.

title: The Tiny Bunch
description: Giraffe and Baby want to sing the friendship song together. Pretty soon the entire bunch are singing and playing to the catchy tune.

title: The Tiny Bunch
description: Baby wants to play with his friends but they are all busy. Squirrel is working in his garden, Giraffe is cleaning her roof.

title: The Tiny Bunch
description: Elephant and Baby have come over to Rabbit's house to have some of his delicious carrot cake.

title: Bath Tubbies
description: Ellie looks for the ball in the water and sees another elephant copying his movements! Ducky and Froggy see a duck and frog in the water too.

title: Bath Tubbies
description: Come have fun with bubbles in the tub! Froggy has a bubble head, Ellie gets a bubble beard and Ducky looks like a sheep.

title: Bath Tubbies
description: Ellie and Froggy are planning a surprise birthday party for Ducky! Help hang balloons and decorate the cake.

title: Look What I Found
description: The friends play with a pot and a spoon! The pot flips over and turns into a drum.

title: Look What I Found
description: The friends have fun sweeping with a broom! Come along as the broom turns into a happy horse.

title: Look What I Found
description: The friends play with chairs that turn into train seats! Join the ride! The train gets stuck on a mountain.

title: Cuddlies
description: Uh Oh gets stuck on the roof while cleaning the window. The friends try to help but get stuck as well.

title: Cuddlies
description: His friends pick out beautiful paintings as a presents and Dodo misses his art paintings.
